Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

public class PartitionDeciBinary {
    public int minPartitions(String n) {
        int max = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n.length(); i++) {
            int digit = n.charAt(i) - '0';
            if (digit > max) {
                max = digit;
            }
            if (max == 9) {
                return max;
            }

        }

        return max;
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        PartitionDeciBinary obj = new PartitionDeciBinary();
        System.out.println(obj.minPartitions("47"));
        System.out.println(obj.minPartitions("82734"));
        System.out.println(obj.minPartitions("27346209830709182346"));

    }
}
